caseNameFull: City of Tacoma v. Taxpayers of Tacoma, Washington
attorneys: Northcutt Ely, Marshall McCormick, Frank L. Bannon and Robert L. McCarty for petitioner. John J. O’Connell, Attorney General, E. P. Donnelly, Assistant Attorney General, and Joseph T.
